def parse_proxy(value: str) -> PrivateRoute:
    try:
        require(isinstance(value, str) and bool(value) and not any(ord(c) <= 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value), "proxy_assignment")
        u = urlsplit(value)
        require(u.scheme in ("http", "https") and bool(u.hostname) and u.path in ("", "/")
                and not u.query and not u.fragment and "?" not in value and "#" not in value
                and "\\" not in value, "proxy_assignment")
        require(u.scheme == "https" or (u.username is None and u.password is None), "proxy_assignment")
        require((u.username is None) == (u.password is None), "proxy_assignment")
        host = u.hostname.encode("idna").decode("ascii").lower()
        require("%" not in host and not host.endswith("."), "proxy_assignment")
        port = u.port if u.port is not None else (443 if u.scheme == "https" else 80)
        require(1 <= port <= 65535, "proxy_assignment")
        if ":" in host:
            host = "[" + str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(host)) + "]"
        auth = None if u.username is None else (unquote(u.username), unquote(u.password))
        if auth is not None:
            require(all(auth) and ":" not in auth[0] and all(not any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in s) for s in auth), "proxy_assignment")
        return PrivateRoute(f"{u.scheme}://{host}:{port}", auth)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeError, AttributeError):
        pass
    raise ProxyFailure("proxy_assignment")

snippets.description: Bounded exact one-CONNECT framing; no partial forwarding
snippets.content:
class ConnectFrame:
    """One bounded CONNECT frame. Never forwards a partial or ambiguous header."""
    def __init__(self, bindings: Mapping[bytes, bytes]):
        self.bindings = bindings
        self.pending = bytearray()
        self.done = False

    def feed(self, data: bytes) -> bytes | None:
        if self.done:
            return data
        require(len(self.pending) + len(data) <= 16384, "proxy_transport")
        self.pending.extend(data)
        marker = self.pending.find(b"\r\n\r\n")
        if marker < 0:
            return None
        require(marker + 4 == len(self.pending), "proxy_transport")
        rows = bytes(self.pending[:-4]).split(b"\r\n")
        parts = rows[0].split(b" ")
        require(len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == b"CONNECT" and parts[2] == b"HTTP/1.1" and parts[1] in self.bindings, "proxy_transport")
        original = parts[1]
        target = self.bindings[original]
        require(re.fullmatch(rb"(?:[0-9.]+|\[[0-9a-fA-F:]+\]):[0-9]{1,5}", target) is not None, "proxy_transport")
        try:
            host, port = target.decode("ascii").rsplit(":", 1)
            ipaddress.ip_address(host.strip("[]"))
            require(1 <= int(port) <= 65535, "proxy_transport")
        except (ValueError, UnicodeError):
            target = None
        require(target is not None, "proxy_transport")
        result = [b"CONNECT " + target + b" HTTP/1.1"]
        hosts = 0
        seen = set()
        for row in rows[1:]:
            require(bool(row) and not row.startswith((b" ", b"\t")) and b":" in row, "proxy_transport")
            key, value = row.split(b":", 1)
            require(re.fullmatch(rb"[!#$%&'*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+", key) is not None and not any(c < 32 and c != 9 or c == 127 for c in value), "proxy_transport")
            name = key.lower()
            require(name not in seen, "proxy_transport")
            seen.add(name)
            require(name not in (b"content-length", b"transfer-encoding", b"connection", b"upgrade"), "proxy_transport")
            if name == b"host":
                hosts += 1
                require(value.strip() == original, "proxy_transport")
                result.append(b"Host: " + target)
            else:
                require(name in (b"accept", b"proxy-authorization", b"user-agent"), "proxy_transport")
                result.append(row)
        require(hosts == 1, "proxy_transport")
        self.pending.clear()
        self.done = True
        return b"\r\n".join(result) + b"\r\n\r\n"

class NumericProxyTransport(httpx.AsyncBaseTransport):
    def __init__(self, route: p.PrivateRoute, policy: p.Policy, *, resolver=resolve_public,
                 origin_context=None, proxy_context=None, backend_factory=BoundBackend,
                 limit=p.X_LIMIT, allow_content_encoding=False):
        self.route, self.policy = route, policy
        self.resolver, self.backend_factory, self.limit = resolver, backend_factory, limit
        self.allow_content_encoding = allow_content_encoding
        self.origin_context = origin_context or httpx.create_ssl_context(verify=True, trust_env=False)
        self.proxy_context = proxy_context or httpx.create_ssl_context(verify=True, trust_env=False)
        p.require(self.origin_context.check_hostname and self.origin_context.verify_mode == 2
                  and self.proxy_context.check_hostname and self.proxy_context.verify_mode == 2, "proxy_policy")
        self.pools = set()

    async def handle_async_request(self, request):
        pool = None
        try:
            deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 10
            connect_deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 5
            async with asyncio.timeout_at(deadline - 1):
                self.policy.validate_url(str(request.url))
                p.require(request.method in ("GET", "POST"), "proxy_policy")
                origin = request.url.host
                port = request.url.port or 443
                async with asyncio.timeout_at(connect_deadline):
                    address = await self.resolver(origin, port)
                proxy = urlsplit(self.route.url)
                proxy_port = proxy.port or (443 if proxy.scheme == "https" else 80)
                async with asyncio.timeout_at(connect_deadline):
                    proxy_address = await self.resolver(proxy.hostname, proxy_port)
                # Match the pinned core's original authority exactly; it omits
                # brackets for literal IPv6. The forwarded numeric authority is
                # always correctly bracketed by the validated frame below.
                original = f"{origin}:{port}".encode("ascii")
                numeric = (f"[{address}]:{port}" if ":" in address else f"{address}:{port}").encode("ascii")
                backend = self.backend_factory(proxy.hostname, proxy_port, proxy_address, original, numeric)
                auth = None if self.route.auth is None else tuple(v.encode("utf-8") for v in self.route.auth)
                pool = httpcore.AsyncHTTPProxy(proxy_url=self.route.url,
                    proxy_auth=auth, ssl_context=self.origin_context,
                    proxy_ssl_context=self.proxy_context if proxy.scheme == "https" else None,
                    network_backend=backend, retries=0, max_connections=1, max_keepalive_connections=0,
                    http1=True, http2=False)
                self.pools.add(pool)
                headers = [(k, v) for k, v in request.headers.raw if k.lower() not in (b"accept-encoding", b"proxy-authorization")]
                headers.append((b"accept-encoding", b"identity"))
                core_request = httpcore.Request(request.method, httpcore.URL(scheme=request.url.raw_scheme,
                    host=request.url.raw_host, port=port, target=request.url.raw_path),
                    headers=headers, content=request.stream,
                    extensions={"timeout": {"connect": max(0.001, connect_deadline - asyncio.get_running_loop().time()),
                                             "read": 10, "write": 10, "pool": 5}})
                async with asyncio.timeout_at(connect_deadline):
                    response = await pool.handle_async_request(core_request)
                p.require(not 300 <= response.status < 400, "proxy_redirect")
                encoding = [v for k, v in response.headers if k.lower() == b"content-encoding"]
                p.require(not encoding or encoding == [b"identity"] or
                    self.allow_content_encoding and len(encoding) == 1 and encoding[0] in (b"gzip", b"deflate"), "proxy_response")
                return httpx.Response(response.status, headers=response.headers,
                    stream=CoreBody(response, pool, deadline, self.limit, self.pools), extensions=response.extensions)

snippets.description: Explicit direct-mode trust/retry/response floor
snippets.content:
class DirectTransport(httpx.AsyncBaseTransport):
    """Explicit direct/off compatibility, with the same trust/retry/resource floor."""
    def __init__(self):
        origin = httpx.create_ssl_context(verify=True, trust_env=False)
        self.transport = httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport(verify=origin, trust_env=False, retries=0,
                                                limits=httpx.Limits(max_keepalive_connections=0))

    async def handle_async_request(self, request):
        deadline = asyncio.get_running_loop().time() + 10
        request.headers["accept-encoding"] = "identity"
        async with asyncio.timeout_at(deadline - 1):
            response = await self.transport.handle_async_request(request)
            if 300 <= response.status_code < 400 or response.headers.get("content-encoding", "identity") != "identity":
                await response.aclose()
                raise p.ProxyFailure("proxy_response")
            response.stream = LimitedBody(response.stream, deadline, p.X_LIMIT)
            return response

    async def aclose(self):
        async with asyncio.timeout(1):
            await self.transport.aclose()


def direct_client(*, headers=None, cookies=None):
    return httpx.AsyncClient(transport=DirectTransport(), trust_env=False, follow_redirects=False,
                            headers=headers, cookies=cookies, timeout=httpx.Timeout(10, connect=5))

Curl partial-retirement ownership and native cleanup
snippets.content:
async def retire_session(session):
    """Retire session-local ownership; retain every handle on partial failure."""
    from curl_cffi import lib
    session._b2_retired = False
    handles = getattr(session, "_b2_handles", set())
    session._b2_handles = handles
    failures = []
    def attempt(operation):
        try:
            return operation()
        except Exception:
            failures.append(True)
            return None
    multi = session._acurl
    checker = None
    if multi is not None:
        p.require(all(hasattr(multi, name) for name in
            ("_timeout_checker", "_curl2future", "_curl2curl", "_curlm", "_sockfds", "_timer", "loop")), "proxy_policy")
        checker = multi._timeout_checker
        checker.cancel()
        handles.update(multi._curl2curl.values())
        handles.update(multi._curl2future)
        if multi._curlm is not None:
            for curl, future in tuple(multi._curl2future.items()):
                attempt(lambda: lib.curl_multi_remove_handle(multi._curlm, curl._curl))
                if not future.done():
                    future.cancel()
        removed = set()
        for descriptor in tuple(multi._sockfds):
            before = len(failures)
            attempt(lambda: multi.loop.remove_reader(descriptor))
            attempt(lambda: multi.loop.remove_writer(descriptor))
            if before == len(failures):
                removed.add(descriptor)
        if multi._timer:
            before = len(failures)
            attempt(multi._timer.cancel)
            if before == len(failures):
                multi._timer = None
        if multi._curlm is not None:
            result = attempt(lambda: lib.curl_multi_cleanup(multi._curlm))
            p.require(result == 0, "proxy_transport")
            multi._curlm = None
        # Native cleanup may invoke the pinned callbacks; retain their socket
        # membership until then and cancel any final callback-installed timer.
        multi._sockfds.difference_update(removed)
        if multi._timer:
            before = len(failures)
            attempt(multi._timer.cancel)
            if before == len(failures):
                multi._timer = None
        multi._curl2future.clear()
        multi._curl2curl.clear()
    session._closed = True
    while not session.pool.empty():
        curl = session.pool.get_nowait()
        if curl is not None:
            handles.add(curl)
    for curl in tuple(handles):
        before = len(failures)
        attempt(curl.close)
        if before == len(failures):
            handles.remove(curl)
    if checker is not None:
        await asyncio.gather(checker, return_exceptions=True)
    session._b2_retired = not handles and not failures
    p.require(not failures and session._b2_retired, "proxy_transport")

                    p.require(not 300 <= result.status_code < 400, "proxy_redirect")

def actual_service_sid() -> str:
    """Resolve the process token user; never trust an environment identity string."""
    require(os.name == "nt", "proxy_private")
    from ctypes import wintypes as w
    adv = ctypes.WinDLL("advapi32", use_last_error=True)
    kernel = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    kernel.GetCurrentProcess.restype = w.HANDLE
    adv.OpenProcessToken.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, w.DWORD, ctypes.POINTER(w.HANDLE)]
    adv.GetTokenInformation.argtypes = [w.HANDLE, w.DWORD, ctypes.c_void_p, w.DWORD, ctypes.POINTER(w.DWORD)]
    adv.ConvertSidToStringSidW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(w.LPWSTR)]
    kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = [w.HANDLE]
    kernel.LocalFree.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    token = w.HANDLE()
    require(bool(adv.OpenProcessToken(kernel.GetCurrentProcess(), 8, ctypes.byref(token))), "proxy_private")
    try:
        needed = w.DWORD()
        adv.GetTokenInformation(token, 1, None, 0, ctypes.byref(needed))
        require(0 < needed.value <= 65536, "proxy_private")
        buf = ctypes.create_string_buffer(needed.value)
        require(bool(adv.GetTokenInformation(token, 1, buf, needed.value, ctypes.byref(needed))), "proxy_private")
        sid = ctypes.cast(buf, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)).contents
        text = w.LPWSTR()
        require(bool(adv.ConvertSidToStringSidW(sid, ctypes.byref(text))), "proxy_private")
        try:
            return text.value
        finally:
            kernel.LocalFree(ctypes.cast(text, ctypes.c_void_p))

def atomic_bytes(path: Path, data: bytes, *, service_sid: str | None = None):
    if service_sid is None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
    else:
        secure_directory(path.parent, service_sid=service_sid)
    temporary = path.with_name("." + path.name + "." + str(uuid4()))
    try:
        fd = (_windows_create(temporary, service_sid, directory=False)
              if os.name == "nt" and service_sid is not None else
              os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600))
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
        if os.name == "posix":
            fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
            try:
                os.fsync(fd)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
    except OSError:
        raise ProxyFailure("proxy_private") from None
    finally:
        temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def secure_database_file(path, policy, repo_root, *, create=False):
    p.require(path.is_absolute() and policy.private_root in path.parents, "proxy_private")
    secure_directory(path.parent, service_sid=policy.service_sid)
    if not path.exists():
        p.require(create, "proxy_private")
        fd = (_windows_create(path, policy.service_sid, directory=False) if os.name == "nt" else
              os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600))
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    with verified_database_open(path, policy.private_root, repo_root=repo_root, service_sid=policy.service_sid) as stream:
        info = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        p.require(info.st_ino != 0, "proxy_private")
        header = stream.read(100) if path.suffix == ".db" else b""
        if path.suffix == ".db" and info.st_size:
            p.require(len(header) == 100 and header[:16] == b"SQLite format 3\x00"
                      and header[18:20] == b"\x01\x01", "proxy_private")
        return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino)

                    import aiosqlite
                    await module.check_version()
                    connection = await aiosqlite.connect(str(path))

                    # Set connection-local locking before the first database

                    await connection.execute("PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY")
                    async with connection.execute("PRAGMA temp_store") as cursor:
                        row = await cursor.fetchone()
                        p.require(row is not None and row[0] == 2, "proxy_private")
                    # Scope transaction verification to this connection, including
                    # commits inside upstream migrations/cookie helpers.
                    for operation in ("commit", "rollback"):
                        original_operation = getattr(connection, operation)
                        async def checked_transaction(operation=original_operation):
                            failure = None
                            try:
                                guard.after(path, policy)
                                result = await operation()
                                guard.after(path, policy)
                                return result
                            except Exception as error:
                                failure = error.reason if isinstance(error, p.ProxyFailure) else "proxy_private"
                            guard.broken.add(path)
                            raise guard.abort(failure)
                        setattr(connection, operation, checked_transaction)
                    guard.after(path, policy)
                    if not self._init_once[self.db_path]:
                        await module.migrate(connection)
                        self._init_once[self.db_path] = True
                    self.conn = connection

def load_snapshot(config_path: Path, *, repo_root: Path, opener=verified_open):
    p.require(config_path.is_absolute(), "proxy_private")
    # Discovery bytes select only the root/SID to inspect; they are never used
    # to construct a client, resolve a route or execute a request.
    discovery_config = read_bounded(config_path, 1024 * 1024)
    try:
        discovered = web_queries.validate(p.strict_json(discovery_config, limit=1024 * 1024)).config
        p.require(discovered.x_proxy_policy_path is not None, "proxy_config")
        policy_path = Path(discovered.x_proxy_policy_path)
        discovery_policy = read_bounded(policy_path, p.SMALL_LIMIT)
        policy = p.parse_policy(discovery_policy, policy_path.parent)
        root = policy_path.parent
        paths = (config_path, policy_path, Path(discovered.x_proxy_assignments_path), Path(discovered.x_proxy_list_path))
        p.require(all(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve(strict=True) == path for path in paths), "proxy_private")
        roles = []
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            streams = [stack.enter_context(opener(path, root, repo_root=repo_root, service_sid=policy.service_sid)) for path in paths]
            for role, path, stream, limit in zip(ROLES, paths, streams,
                    (1024 * 1024, p.SMALL_LIMIT, p.SMALL_LIMIT, 1024 * 1024)):
                roles.append((role, str(path), handle_bytes(stream, limit)))
            p.require(roles[0][2] == discovery_config and roles[1][2] == discovery_policy, "proxy_revision")
            config = web_queries.validate(p.strict_json(roles[0][2], limit=1024 * 1024)).config
            policy = p.parse_policy(roles[1][2], root)
            assignments = p.parse_assignments(roles[2][2], roles[3][2], config.x_accounts,
                required=config.x_proxy_required,
                identities=config.x_account_identities if config.x_identity_enabled else None)
        return PrivateSnapshot(config, policy, assignments, tuple(roles))
    except (OSError, web_queries.QueriesError, TypeError, ValueError):
        raise p.ProxyFailure("proxy_config") from None

def work_envelope(request):
    p.require(isinstance(request.get("label"), str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]{1,24}", request["label"]), "proxy_config")
    p.opaque_id(request.get("proxy_id"))
    p.opaque_id(request.get("identity_revision"))
    p.require(request.get("backend") == "curl" and isinstance(request.get("request_nonce"), str)
              and HEX32.fullmatch(request["request_nonce"]) is not None, "proxy_config")
    query, kv = request.get("query"), request.get("kv")
    p.require(isinstance(query, str) and 0 < len(query.encode("utf-8")) <= 4096
              and isinstance(kv, dict) and set(kv) <= {"product", "cursor"}
              and kv.get("product") == "Latest", "proxy_config")
    cursor = kv.get("cursor")
    p.require(cursor is None or isinstance(cursor, str) and len(cursor.encode("utf-8")) <= 4096, "proxy_config")
    expiry = request.get("admission_expires_at")
    p.require(isinstance(expiry, str) and len(expiry) <= 64, "proxy_config")
    return (request["label"].encode(), request["proxy_id"].encode(), request["identity_revision"].encode(),
            request["backend"].encode(), request["request_nonce"].encode(), expiry.encode(),
            query.encode("utf-8"), b"Latest", b"null" if cursor is None else b"present", b"" if cursor is None else cursor.encode("utf-8"))


def digest(key: bytes, roles, request) -> str:
    p.require(len(key) == 32 and tuple(role for role, _, _ in roles) == ROLES, "proxy_revision")
    mac = hmac.new(key, DOMAIN, hashlib.sha256)
    def frame(value):
        mac.update(len(value).to_bytes(8, "big"))
        mac.update(value)
    for role, path, raw in roles:
        frame(role.encode("ascii"))
        frame(path.encode("utf-8"))
        frame(raw)
    for value in work_envelope(request):
        frame(value)
    return mac.hexdigest()


def attest(roles, request):
    key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
    request["attestation_key"] = key.hex()
    request["attestation_tag"] = digest(key, roles, request)


def verify(roles, request):
    key, tag = request.get("attestation_key"), request.get("attestation_tag")
    p.require(isinstance(key, str) and isinstance(tag, str) and HEX32.fullmatch(key) is not None
              and HEX32.fullmatch(tag) is not None, "proxy_revision")
    expected = digest(bytes.fromhex(key), roles, request)
    p.require(hmac.compare_digest(expected, tag), "proxy_revision")

snippets.content:
def admission_role(private, label, revision, *, now, repo_root):
    from api.data.attention.x_proxy_runtime import FeedCache, private_read
    p.require(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9_]{1,24}", label) is not None and label in private.config.x_accounts
              and label in private.assignments, "proxy_assignment")
    p.require(UUID(p.opaque_id(revision)).version == 4, "proxy_revision")
    policy = private.policy
    path = policy.cache_dir / "admissions" / (label + ".json")
    try:
        canonical = path.resolve(strict=True)
        p.require(canonical == path, "proxy_private")
        path = canonical
    except OSError:
        raise p.ProxyFailure("proxy_private") from None
    raw = private_read(path, policy, repo_root, p.SMALL_LIMIT)
    record = p.exact(p.strict_json(raw), ADMISSION_KEYS)
    try:
        checked = datetime.fromisoformat(record["checked_at"])
        expiry = datetime.fromisoformat(record["expires_at"])
        p.require(checked.tzinfo is not None and expiry.tzinfo is not None
            and checked.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0 and expiry.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0
            and checked <= now < expiry
            and (expiry - checked).total_seconds() <= private.config.x_proxy_admission_max_age_seconds,
            "proxy_revision")
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        raise p.ProxyFailure("proxy_revision") from None
    p.require(record["identity_revision"] == revision
        and record["proxy_id"] == private.assignments[label].proxy_id, "proxy_revision")
    feeds = p.exact(record["feeds"], ("spamhaus", "firehol"))
    cache = FeedCache(policy.cache_dir, policy=policy, repo_root=repo_root)
    for slot, expected in feeds.items():
        p.opaque_id(expected)
        feed, current = cache.load(slot, now)
        p.require(current == expected and expiry <= feed.expires_at, "proxy_revision")
        p.require(not feed.contains(private.assignments[label].expected_ip), "proxy_feed")
    return ("safe-admission", str(path), raw), record

def prepare(runtime, label, query, kv):
    p.require(runtime.admitted(label), "proxy_revision")
    private = runtime.snapshot_loader(runtime.config_path, repo_root=runtime.repo_root)
    p.require(private.roles == runtime.snapshot.private_snapshot.roles, "proxy_revision")
    revision = runtime.snapshot.revisions[label]
    role, record = admission_role(private, label, revision, now=runtime.clock(), repo_root=runtime.repo_root)
    request = SensitiveRequest({"config_path": private.roles[0][1], "label": label,
        "proxy_id": private.assignments[label].proxy_id, "identity_revision": revision,
        "backend": "curl", "request_nonce": secrets.token_hex(32),
        "admission_expires_at": record["expires_at"], "query": query, "kv": dict(kv)})
    work_envelope(request)
    attest((*private.roles, role), request)
    return request


def reload_verified(request, *, repo_root, now, snapshot_loader=None):
    from api.data.attention.x_proxy_snapshot import load_snapshot
    p.exact(request, REQUEST_KEYS)
    work_envelope(request)
    path = request["config_path"]
    p.require(isinstance(path, str) and Path(path).is_absolute(), "proxy_private")
    private = (snapshot_loader or load_snapshot)(Path(path), repo_root=repo_root)
    role, record = admission_role(private, request["label"], request["identity_revision"], now=now, repo_root=repo_root)
    p.require(record["expires_at"] == request["admission_expires_at"]
              and record["proxy_id"] == request["proxy_id"], "proxy_revision")
    verify((*private.roles, role), request)
    return private, record


def validate_reply(runtime, request, reply):
    p.require(isinstance(reply, dict) and reply.get("request_nonce") == request["request_nonce"]
              and reply.get("identity_revision") == request["identity_revision"], "proxy_revision")
    p.require(runtime.admitted(request["label"])
              and runtime.snapshot.revisions.get(request["label"]) == request["identity_revision"], "proxy_revision")
    private = runtime.snapshot_loader(runtime.config_path, repo_root=runtime.repo_root)
    p.require(private.roles == runtime.snapshot.private_snapshot.roles, "proxy_revision")
    role, record = admission_role(private, request["label"], request["identity_revision"], now=runtime.clock(), repo_root=runtime.repo_root)
    p.require(record["expires_at"] == request["admission_expires_at"], "proxy_revision")
    # Authenticate the reloaded roles against the same short-lived proof, too.
    verify((*private.roles, role), request)

snippets.content:
def publish(self, slot, body, now):
        feed = p.parse_feed(slot, body, now)
        revision = str(uuid4())
        root = self.directory / slot / revision
        sid = self.policy.service_sid if self.policy is not None else None
        if sid:
            secure_directory(root, service_sid=sid)
        else:
            root.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
        atomic_bytes(root / "body", body, service_sid=sid)
        atomic_json(root / "metadata.json", {"retrieved_at": now.isoformat(),
            "source_version": list(feed.source_version), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()}, service_sid=sid)
        atomic_json(self.directory / slot / "current.json", {"revision": revision}, service_sid=sid)
        return feed, revision

    def load(self, slot, now):
        p.require(slot in ("spamhaus", "firehol"), "proxy_feed")
        pointer = p.exact(p.strict_json(self.read(self.directory / slot / "current.json", p.SMALL_LIMIT)), ("revision",))
        revision = p.opaque_id(pointer["revision"])
        root = self.directory / slot / revision
        body = self.read(root / "body", p.FEED_DECODED_LIMIT)
        metadata = p.exact(p.strict_json(self.read(root / "metadata.json", p.SMALL_LIMIT)), ("retrieved_at", "source_version", "sha256"))
        retrieved = _stamp(metadata["retrieved_at"], now)
        p.require(now - retrieved <= timedelta(days=1) and metadata["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(), "proxy_feed")
        feed = p.parse_feed(slot, body, now)
        p.require(metadata["source_version"] == list(feed.source_version), "proxy_feed")
        return feed, revision

snippets.description: One-shot bounded wire/decompression/cleanup path
snippets.content:
async def one_shot(route, policy, url, limit):
    """Dedicated one-shot HTTP client, bounded while streaming and during cleanup."""
    from api.data.attention.x_proxy_transport import client
    reason = None
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(10):
            async with client(route, policy, limit=limit, allow_content_encoding=True) as session:
                async with session.stream("GET", url, headers={"accept-encoding": "identity"}) as response:
                    p.require(response.status_code == 200, "proxy_response")
                    import zlib
                    body = bytearray()
                    decoded_limit = p.FEED_DECODED_LIMIT if url in (p.SPAMHAUS, p.FIREHOL) else limit
                    encoding = response.headers.get("content-encoding", "identity")
                    decoder = zlib.decompressobj(31 if encoding == "gzip" else 15) if encoding != "identity" else None
                    async for chunk in response.aiter_raw():
                        remaining = decoded_limit - len(body)
                        decoded = decoder.decompress(chunk, remaining + 1) if decoder else chunk
                        p.require(len(decoded) <= remaining and (decoder is None or not decoder.unconsumed_tail), "proxy_response")
                        body.extend(decoded)
                    if decoder:
                        remaining = decoded_limit - len(body)
                        final = decoder.flush(remaining + 1)
                        p.require(len(final) <= remaining and decoder.eof and not decoder.unused_data, "proxy_response")
                        body.extend(final)
                    return bytes(body)
    except TimeoutError:
        reason = "proxy_timeout"
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = exc.reason if isinstance(exc, p.ProxyFailure) else "proxy_transport"
    raise p.ProxyFailure(reason) from None

snippets.content:
def _health_reserve(self, label, pool):
        now = _utc(self.clock())
        path = self.snapshot.policy.cache_dir / "health" / (label + ".json")
        with state_lock(pool.path):
            history = []
            if path.exists():
                record = p.exact(p.strict_json(private_read(path, self.snapshot.policy, self.repo_root, p.SMALL_LIMIT)), ("attempts",))
                p.require(isinstance(record["attempts"], list) and len(record["attempts"]) <= 24, "proxy_budget")
                history = [_stamp(value, now) for value in record["attempts"]]
            latest = max(history) if history else None
            history = [stamp for stamp in history if stamp.date() == now.date()]
            interval = timedelta(seconds=self.snapshot.config.x_proxy_health_interval_seconds)
            p.require(len(history) < 24 and (latest is None or now - latest >= interval), "proxy_budget")
            atomic_json(path, {"attempts": [stamp.isoformat() for stamp in history] + [now.isoformat()]},
                        service_sid=self.snapshot.policy.service_sid)

snippets.description: Sequential six-step/60-second admission, expected exit, feeds/provider/baseline
snippets.content:
def admit(self, label, pool):
        snapshot = self.snapshot
        p.require(snapshot is not None, "proxy_revision")
        if snapshot.policy is None:
            return
        if self.admitted(label) and _utc(self.clock()) < self.admissions[label].checked_at + timedelta(seconds=snapshot.config.x_proxy_health_interval_seconds):
            return
        state = pool._acct(label)
        now = _utc(self.clock())
        if state["proxy_quarantine_until"]:
            p.require(now >= datetime.fromisoformat(state["proxy_quarantine_until"]), "proxy_quarantine")
        self._health_reserve(label, pool)
        assignment = snapshot.assignments[label]
        policy = snapshot.policy
        started = time.monotonic()
        expires = [now + timedelta(seconds=snapshot.config.x_proxy_admission_max_age_seconds)]
        calls = 0
        def fetch(url, limit):
            nonlocal calls
            calls += 1
            p.require(calls <= 6 and time.monotonic() - started < 60, "proxy_timeout")
            async def run():
                async with asyncio.timeout(min(10, max(0, 60 - (time.monotonic() - started)))):
                    return await self.request(assignment.route, policy, url, limit)
            try:
                return asyncio.run(run())
            except TimeoutError:
                raise p.ProxyFailure("proxy_timeout") from None
        try:
            echo = p.strict_json(fetch(policy.echo, p.SMALL_LIMIT))
            p.require(isinstance(echo, dict) and isinstance(echo.get("ip"), str)
                      and p.normalized_ip(echo["ip"]) == assignment.expected_ip, "proxy_exit")
            cache = FeedCache(policy.cache_dir, policy=policy, repo_root=self.repo_root)
            feed_revisions = {}
            for slot, url in (("spamhaus", p.SPAMHAUS), ("firehol", p.FIREHOL)):
                try:
                    feed, revision = cache.load(slot, now)
                except p.ProxyFailure:
                    feed, revision = cache.publish(slot, fetch(url, p.FEED_WIRE_LIMIT), now)
                p.require(not feed.contains(assignment.expected_ip), "proxy_feed")
                expires.append(feed.expires_at)
                feed_revisions[slot] = revision
            if policy.metadata_provider == "ipapi":
                data = p.strict_json(pool.provider_request(lambda: fetch(p.IPAPI, p.SMALL_LIMIT)))
                p.require(isinstance(data, dict) and all(isinstance(data.get(k), str) for k in
                    ("ip", "region_code", "country_code", "timezone")), "proxy_region")
                p.require(p.normalized_ip(data["ip"]) == assignment.expected_ip
                    and data["country_code"].upper() == assignment.region.split("-", 1)[0]
                    and ("-" not in assignment.region or data["region_code"].upper() == assignment.region.split("-", 1)[1])
                    and data["timezone"] == assignment.timezone, "proxy_region")
            baseline = fetch(policy.baseline, p.BASELINE_LIMIT)
            p.require(hashlib.sha256(baseline).hexdigest() == policy.baseline_sha256, "proxy_baseline")
            p.require(time.monotonic() - started <= 60, "proxy_timeout")
            self.admissions[label] = Admission(assignment.proxy_id, snapshot.revisions[label], now, min(expires), tuple(feed_revisions.items()))
            atomic_json(policy.cache_dir / "admissions" / (label + ".json"),
                {"proxy_id": assignment.proxy_id, "identity_revision": snapshot.revisions[label],
                 "checked_at": now.isoformat(), "expires_at": min(expires).isoformat(),
                 "feeds": feed_revisions}, service_sid=policy.service_sid)
            pool.proxy_result(label, reason=None)
        except p.ProxyFailure as failure:
            self.admissions.pop(label, None)
            pool.proxy_result(label, reason=failure.reason,
                              quarantine_seconds=snapshot.config.x_proxy_quarantine_seconds)
            raise p.ProxyFailure(failure.reason) from None

Exact state/provider-budget validation and safe migration input types
Durable 899/day provider reservation, midnight deferral, lock through send and no refund
snippets.content:
def provider_request(self, send):
        """Reserve durably before a one-shot send; lock remains held to completion."""
        xp.require(self._lock_owned is None, "proxy_lock")
        with state_lock(self.path) as ownership:
            self._lock_owned = ownership
            try:
                self._s = self._load()
                now = self._now()
                midnight = datetime.combine(now.date() + timedelta(days=1), time(), tzinfo=timezone.utc)
                xp.require((midnight - now).total_seconds() > 11, "proxy_budget")
                budget = self._s["proxy_provider_budget"]
                today = now.date().isoformat()
                xp.require(budget["day"] is None or budget["day"] <= today, "proxy_budget")
                if budget["day"] is None or budget["day"] < today:
                    budget.update(day=today, used=0)
                xp.require(budget["used"] < 899, "proxy_budget")
                budget["used"] += 1
                self._save()
                xp.require(self._now().date().isoformat() == today, "proxy_budget")
                return send()
            finally:
                self._lock_owned = None

def refresh_cookies(label: str, cookies: str, *, config: CollectorConfig, env: Mapping[str, str] = os.environ,
                    now: datetime, repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT, load: Callable[[], Library] = load_library,
                    config_path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    """The cookie upsert `pool.add_account_cookies(label, cookies)` on that account's own file."""
    import asyncio

    if label not in config.x_accounts:
        raise ValueError("label is not configured")
    selected_backend = "curl" if config.x_connection_style == "curl" else "httpx"
    bad = env_guard(env, selected_backend=selected_backend)
    problems = [f"env:{name}" for name in bad]
    problems += [p for p in accounts_problems(config, repo_root=repo_root) if p != "missing_account_file"]
    if config.x_connection_style == "curl":
        status = curl_status(read_install_record(), platform_key(), find_dist("curl_cffi"))
        if status != "ok":
            problems.append(f"curl:{status}")
    if problems:
        raise XStartRefused(problems)
    path = Path(config.x_accounts_db_path) / f"{label}.db"
    adapter = None
    runtime = None
    if config.x_proxy_required or any(value is not None for value in
            (config.x_proxy_list_path, config.x_proxy_assignments_path, config.x_proxy_policy_path)):
        from api.data.attention import x_proxy as xp
        from api.data.attention.x_proxy_runtime import ProxyRuntime, Snapshot

            xp.require(config_path is not None, "proxy_config")

            xp.require(private.config == config, "proxy_revision")
            runtime = ProxyRuntime(config, config_path=config_path, repo_root=repo_root)
            runtime.snapshot = Snapshot(config, private.policy, private.assignments, {}, Path(config_path), private)
        except xp.ProxyFailure as failure:
            raise XStartRefused([failure.reason]) from None
    try:

                config.x_account_identities if config.x_identity_enabled else {}, runtime=runtime)
